verdict.rationale: The official CLI documents a one-line install of a whole collection (`npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills`), with flags for targeting agents, global versus project scope, and a non-interactive `-y` mode. Skills are written into each agent's skills directory, and the Agent Skills spec states agents load available skills at startup, so they are picked up in the next session. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that installed skills activate in the next agent session (activation is inferred from the install paths and the spec's startup-discovery claim).
